# Joining questions remain exact under the same encoding

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

After encoding every joining partner in a question through the same account, interpreting the translated question in the induced multivalued joining relation gives exactly the original answer.

Canonical source: [ExplanatoryJoiningBranches.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/ExplanatoryJoiningBranches.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- One partial joining relation J; each input pair has a finite outcome set.
- The target contains all finite negation, conjunction and left/right joining-successor questions, with no independent atomic predicates.
- Exact supplies complete truthful answers; Reduced is used for minimal codes and lifting output codes.

Fragments, joining and its questions interpret relations within the same activity; mathematical semantics does not establish acquired access to every answer.
